body:
# Ever thought ancient debris look like a **_cinnamon bun_**? 

![You have the normal Ancient Debris? Eww. Try the new cinnamon ancient debris :D!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbac29e0fc021e3510f659539b90bd9fd63e8c5e.jpeg)Hello :D

## Introducing... _Cinnamon Buns Pack_!!! Here you can find the best of the best ancient debris!! Its easy to find and it looks like a Cinnamon bun, so why not get it??

## Want more then just Ancient Debris as Cinnamon Buns? Stay tuned, i might update this pack with some new and fresh features! What about an choclate bar as an netherite ingot??

### (BTW, this is my first resourcepack i ever made so its lots to improve!!)

### If you like the pack, thanks i worked on it for maybe **_2_** hours :D
